projects.name: nibli
projects.desc: Zero-hallucination symbolic reasoning engine — a hallucination firewall for the LLM era. Lojban in, first-order logic out; a proof trace on every conclusion.

projects.name: cognito
projects.desc: Pure-Rust System 2 reasoning kernel — minimal knowledge, maximal logic. A transformer on Burn that thinks in explicit steps.

projects.name: hostscli
projects.desc: Python CLI that blocks and unblocks websites straight from /etc/hosts. Sometimes the best firewall is a text file.

projects.name: awesome-rust-ml
projects.desc: A curated map of the Rust machine-learning ecosystem. Curation is also building: someone has to keep the index honest.

projects.name: STGI
projects.desc: Technical Architect, since May 2026 — backend engineering for niche tech initiatives. The newest chapter.

projects.name: NuFlights
projects.desc: Principal Architect (2023–26) on the airline-retailing platform I originally built at Reckonsys — including rewriting the NDC adapter from Python to Rust (async-graphql, sea-orm).

projects.name: Colligence Research
projects.desc: Principal Architect, Distributed Systems/Rust (2023–25). First MVP of a distributed WebRTC media server in Rust; Pulumi infrastructure-as-code end to end.

projects.name: Appknox ×2
projects.desc: 2014–17: architected the mobile-security scanning platform from scratch, built the team 1→5, ran an iOS/Android device farm. 2022–23: a Rust microservice generating CycloneDX SBOMs from mobile binaries — no source required.

projects.name: Nitimis
projects.desc: CTO for five years (2018–23), non-profit ethos: RobotFramework QA services, and teaching people with zero tech background to start QA-automation careers — unpaid, on purpose.

projects.name: the Reckonsys years
projects.desc: VP of Engineering (2019–22), ~70% hands-on by choice. Django/GraphQL/React for startups, teams of 2–10; open-sourced 'bigga' and the cookiecutter templates everything was scaffolded from.

projects.name: ReWire
projects.desc: An iOS mindfulness app (2012, at Tataatsu) — meditation and attention training, with an API for scores and leaderboards. A one-person team, end to end.

about.tagline: An Optimistic Nihilist who loves Science, Rust, Python, FOSS, WebAssembly, WebRTC, Web3, Distributed Systems, and symbolic reasoning.
